# Security Policy

This policy describes how to report a vulnerability in the Solace Software Event Broker Terraform Provider.

## Supported Versions

We support the latest release of this provider. Older versions do not receive security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues.

Report a vulnerability privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/SolaceProducts/terraform-provider-solacebroker/security/advisories/new).

Include this information in your report:

- a description of the vulnerability
- steps to reproduce the issue
- the potential impact (what an attacker could achieve)
- the affected versions (if known)
- a suggested fix (if you have one)
